newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian mine collapse kills four people.
newsitem.headline: Indian mine collapse kills four people.

text.p: At least four people were killed and 13 injured when a coal mine collapsed in India's northern state of Jammu and Kashmir, an official spokesman said on Tuesday.
"There were 22 miners working inside at the time of the collapse. Five are still trapped inside," the spokesman said.
The mine caved in during the lunch break on Monday in Rajouri district, 133 km (83 miles) from Jammu, the winter capital of the Himalayan state.
"The loss of life would have been colossal had it not been the lunch break," state chief minister Farooq Abdullah told a briefing in Jammu.
Rescue operations by local authorities to evacuate the trapped miners were continuing, Abdullah said.
The government has announced it would pay 100,000 rupees ($2,793) to the relatives of the dead miners.
Abdullah said the federal coal ministry has been asked to investigate the incident.
The Press Trust of India agency said at least nine people were believed to have been killed. ($1= 35.8 rupees)
